examples.arabic: رديت عليها ايوه صحيح الاحزاب السياسية بتقدم مرشحين كتير للانتخابات الجاية
examples.english: I replied to her "Yes, that's right, political parties are presenting many candidates for the upcoming elections."
examples.transliteration: Raddēt ʿalēha "Aywa ṣaḥīḥ el-aḥzāb as-sīyāsīya betʾaddem morashshaḥīn ketīr lel-entikhābāt el-gāyya."

examples.arabic: اه دلوقتي الاحزاب السياسية بتقدم مرشحين كتير والشباب مش مهتم زي زمان
examples.english: Ah, nowadays political parties present many candidates, and young people aren't as interested as before.
examples.transliteration: Ah delwaʾti el-aḥzāb as-sīyāsīya betaʾaddem morashshaḥīn ketīr w esh-shabāb mesh mohtamm zayy zamān.

examples.arabic: امبارح اشتريت كتاب عن الاحزاب السياسية بس اكتشفت انه مش اللي كنت عايزاه
examples.english: Yesterday I bought a book about political parties but I discovered it wasn't what I wanted.
examples.transliteration: Embāreḥ eshtarayt ketāb ʿan el-aḥzāb es-sīyāsīya bas aktashaft ennoh mesh elly kont ʿayzāh.

examples.arabic: شفت راجل كبير قاعد بيقرا جرنان وبيتكلم عن الاحزاب السياسية
examples.english: I saw an old man sitting reading a newspaper and talking about political parties.
examples.transliteration: Shoft ragel kebīr qaʿed beyeqra gornān w beyetkallem ʿan el-aḥzāb as-sīyāsīya
